<etan_status> > <etan_status>  no ENR extension planned, as there were plans by prysm/lighthouse to also support serving the data, which makes it highly likely to connect to a peer serving the data.

regarding implementation, the easiest is to just cache the merkle proofs when applying a new block (when pre-state is available), and then just serving the cached proofs from DB (re @Lightclient_bot: <sproul> ^I checked with @agemanning and topic-based discovery isn't implemented yet (it's harder than you might think).

Maybe <@688748669268132001> or @etan_status could weigh in on whether Nimbus/Lodestar have agreed on an ENR extension for these topics?)
